hero.title: Department of Fashion Design and Technology
hero.subtitle: Nurturing creativity and technical skills for Bangladesh's fashion and apparel industry.

chairman.name: Prof. Nasreen Akter
message: Welcome to the Department of Fashion Design and Technology at Port City International University. Our department offers a wide range of career opportunities for students, from having your own establishment to working for top labels, fashion designers, garment export houses, and textile mills.
Our graduates find successful careers as apparel merchandisers, visual merchandisers, public relations and marketing professionals, stylists, and even lecturers for Fashion Design institutions.

We focus on nurturing creativity while providing strong technical skills in pattern making, garment construction, textile science, and fashion marketing. Our industry connections ensure students gain practical experience through internships and projects with leading fashion houses.

content: The Department of Fashion Design and Technology offers comprehensive programs combining creativity with technical skills in pattern making, garment construction, textile science, and fashion marketing.
